name: International Yoga Day Celebration
description: Join us for a morning of yoga, breathwork, and community wellness to celebrate International Yoga Day in the heart of Ajax.
detailedDescription:
Join us for a vibrant morning of yoga, breathwork, and community wellness as we celebrate International Yoga Day in the heart of Ajax.

This free outdoor event welcomes participants of all ages and experience levels — whether you are a seasoned practitioner or stepping onto the mat for the very first time. Certified instructors will guide attendees through a gentle flow, pranayama breathing exercises, and a closing meditation.

Come connect with neighbours, breathe in the open air, and embrace the spirit of unity and wellbeing that International Yoga Day represents. Bring your own mat if you have one; extras will be available on-site.

Light refreshments will be provided. Free entry — all are welcome!
